format: NDCA Sanctioned events, retention of original score sheets

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Organizers retain the original adjudicators' score sheets for 30 days after the close of the event, in case of a discrepancy in the scrutineers' final markings.

requirement: The organizer checklist names the 30-day minimum and records the organizer's acknowledgement; DanceFlow never retains paper and never deletes evidence automatically.
interpretation_notes: The 30 days is a minimum retention, not a deletion trigger or a correction deadline. Acknowledgement is the organizer's statement, not proof of physical retention. Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
decision_refs: OD-12 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A; retrospective audit PR #795)
